description:
Skilcrew is a global marketplace for both jobs and services. Find work or hire people; offer your services or bring in a professional for a one-off task — the client picks the pro. It covers one-off home services, permanent hiring and IT work. This app connects your Skilcrew account to ChatGPT. The Skilcrew platform itself is localized into 44 languages and listings can carry per-country texts; in ChatGPT the assistant simply replies in your language.

For job seekers and service providers: see who is hiring in your country, browse open vacancies and the client request feed, track your published listings, submitted applications and conversations, and check your plan and quotas. The same account also works as a client: search one-off service providers — plumbers, tutors, movers and more — to bring a professional in. With assistant write access enabled in your Skilcrew cabinet you can also apply to vacancies, reply to client service requests, message providers to order a job, and message clients right from the chat.

For employers and recruiters: search candidate profiles (including anonymous ones), review applications received on your vacancies, follow your recruiting pipelines, draft new vacancy listings and start conversations with candidates.

The connector is role-aware: after sign-in it serves exactly the tool set that matches your account type (job seeker or employer/recruiter). Write tools create or reactivate applications and service-request replies, send messages, and create new listings. The listing-editing tools can replace a listing's country reach and add, overwrite or remove its per-country texts. No tool can edit account credentials, delete an account or listing, or recall a sent message. Every write tool is disabled by default and only works after you explicitly enable assistant posting/messaging in your Skilcrew cabinet; switching a toggle off stops the assistant instantly. Search and listing tools return only what users chose to publish on their listings (including a contact phone when the owner published one); anonymous candidate listings stay masked with no contacts, resume files are never returned, and account emails or internal identifiers are not exposed in catalog results.

defaultPrompt: Who is hiring for permanent jobs near me right now?
Show my Skilcrew listings and check which of my applications got replies.
Find open service requests in my categories and help me reply to one.
